title: The Night Librarian
text:
Long after the last reader has gone, Mr Fernandez begins his rounds. He pushes a squeaking trolley between the shelves, sliding each returned book back into the exact place where somebody will one day look for it.
He has worked in the neighbourhood library for twenty-three years. He can tell you which shelf holds the dinosaur books that primary school boys fight over, and which corner the students claim during examination season.
People sometimes ask whether the work is lonely. Mr Fernandez shakes his head. Every book he shelves, he says, is a small promise to a stranger he will never meet: when you come looking tomorrow, it will be here, waiting for you.
